Display_email_account_type_tip: The authentication type for third-party accounts to log in to the email service provider. For most email service providers, you can use "General Email Service Provider", which is authenticated by username and password; for Gmail accounts, users can choose "General Email Service Provider" or "Gmail", the latter will authenticate Google accounts in OAuth2 mode; for MS365 mailbox users, only "Outlook" mode can be selected to authenticate accounts through OAuth2
Display_host_user_tip: Used to specify the account (or account id) that calls the email service provider's API to send emails. By default, it is "me" (the owner of the web application client). Note: This item cannot be modified after the third-party account is added
Display_client_id_tip: The ID of the mailbox application, used for the first authentication of the third-party account and subsequent token acquisition. Note: This item cannot be modified after the third-party account is added
Display_client_secret_tip: The security key of the mailbox application is used for the first authentication of the third-party account and subsequent token acquisition. Note: This item cannot be modified after the third-party account is added
Display_token_url_tip: Used to obtain the refresh token and access token required by the service provider when the third-party account calls the API related to sending emails. For non-multi-tenant users, there is no need to modify this item. Note: This item cannot be modified after the third-party account is added
Display_authority_tip: Used for third-party account permission authorization and obtaining permission to send emails. For non-multi-tenant users, there is no need to modify this item. Note: This item cannot be modified after the third-party account is added
Creating_thirdparty_email_oauth_account: Create a third-party OAuth2 authenticated email account
Creating_thirdparty_email_oauth_account_: Please add the following URL to the authorized redirect URL directory of the mail application in your third-party account. This URL will be used in the callback when the third-party account authorization is completed.
Display_scopes_tip: After the email account authorization authentication is completed, the accessToken will be obtained from the corresponding scope group in the address. If there are multiple URLs, each URL is separated by a comma (English). For MS365, the default scope is https://graph.microsoft.com/.default
Display_endpoint_tip: API address for submitting email sending requests. For example, for MS365, the corresponding address is https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/<username>/sendMail
